notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Cx2klr_CPWc
Hey all,

We've just pushed a new patch with a few fixes and a new high fidelity American mode to celebrate the 4th of July and our magnificent independence:

- Burgers: HUGE bullet cola shot down to the correct size
- Raise Baby: Baby Bang's food will fix itself if it falls on the floor.
- American mode. 

Thanks again for supporting the game! 

Much love,
Samurai Punk <3

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
Hey all,

We've just pushed a new patch with a bunch of fixes and polish:

- Climax: fixed lighting issues, added more visual effects and feedback
- Climax: made reloading guns more forgiving
- Fixed issue where loading to main menu would result in black screen
- FirstDate: fixed missing sounds on fireworks
- Fix various VO issues
- Fix various subtitle visibility issues

Thanks again for supporting the game! 

Much love,
Samurai Punk <3

notes.title: Hotfix #4
notes.content:
Hey everybody,

We've just uploaded a fix for bug that crept into the last patch where there were no colliders on the ground in the Catch level. This should be resolved now so please try the level again if you were getting stuck there.

Thanks for those who reported the issue and for your patience in waiting for a fix. :)

Much Love,
Samurai Punk <3

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

We've dropped our first patch with a bunch of minor polish accross the board.  We'll be continuing to do further polish but for now we wanted to get some of this clean up work out there. Details below.  

Improvements
[list]
    [*] Added people to lonely feeling First Date
    [*]Candles now have actual flames in Bedroom Scene
    [*]Flashy carnival lights in First Date
    [*]Drive In' level now accessible with snack machine, removed moved some dialogue into these scenes.
    [*]Visual Polish for dull fonts
[*]Large Balloons in Prom now react when shot.
[/list]

Fixes
[list]
    [*] Intermission Collision Pass
    [*] Improved lighting in Calibration, Intermission and Dinner Date
[*]Hanging objects on burgers no longer fall down immediately. 
[*]Fixed missing smoke particles in Burgers

[/list]

Much Love,
Samurai Punk
<3

notes.title: Hotfix #3
notes.content:
Hi Everyone. 

We've rolled another update to resolve some more progress blocking issues players are seeing. Thanks again for your patience.

Fixes
[list]
    [*]Fixed issue where both reload buttons were enabled in Car Wash.
    [*]Fixed issue where the reload buttons were backwards when playing as left hand dominant.
    [*]Fixed issue where the controller vibration could go to the wrong controller on Oculus.
[/list]


Much Love,
Samurai Punk
<3

notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

Thanks for being so supportive around this release and thanks to everyone who's already picked up the game. We've rolled a quick update to resolve consistent issues people are having while we look into some of the more systematic problems.

Fixes:
[list]
    [*]Fix not being able to pick up Wedding ring
    [*]Fix no hints in Dinner Date
    [*]Various narration timing tweaks and general polish
[/list]

For other issues we've made a [url=https://samuraipunk.com/american-dream-known-issues/] list of problems[/url]  we know about and are working to resolve. 

For those who are having the game crash on launch, this appears to be because the game is trying to run Oculus code. Potential workaround is to install Oculus and leave it running in the background. Proper fix coming ASAP! 

Much Love,
Samurai Punk
<3
